title: HUD Annual Homelessness Assessment Report (AHAR) data: Point-in-Time and Housing Inventory Counts
agency: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
questions: number of people experiencing homelessness by state
unsheltered homeless count in a city or Continuum of Care
emergency shelter and permanent supportive housing beds by CoC

manual.how: Open https://www.huduser.gov/portal/datasets/ahar/2025-ahar-part-1-pit-estimates-of-homelessness-in-the-us.html in a web browser and download the workbook (2007 - 2025 Point-in-Time Estimates by CoC or by State, Housing Inventory Count by CoC or State, PIT Veteran Counts); huduser.gov refuses scripts. Upload the workbook as saved (.xlsb or .xlsx) with ingest.

cache.why: Workbooks are replaced once a year with the new AHAR edition.

redistribution.why: HUD's AHAR data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Annual Homelessness Assessment Report (AHAR), {dataset}, HUD User, downloaded {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which year? Each sheet is one count year (a single night in late January). Default: the latest year, with 2020 or the prior year for change.
Which population? Total, sheltered, unsheltered, individuals, people in families, chronically homeless, veterans, youth: these overlap. Default: total, split into sheltered and unsheltered.
Which geography? CoCs are HUD's planning areas (a city, a county or a balance of state), not cities or counties as such. Default: states, or the CoC that contains the place named, said as such.
